```{r}
library(glue)
library(here)
library(mirt)
library(rlang)
library(rlevante)
library(tidyverse)

# TODO: functions in these files should be put in a package
source(here("../levante-pilots/02_score_data/02_fit_irt/irt_helpers.R"))
source(here("../levante-pilots/02_score_data/02_fit_irt/irt_modular.R"), chdir = TRUE)
source(here("../levante-pilots/02_score_data/02_fit_irt/registry_helper.R"))
source(here("../levante-pilots/02_score_data/02_fit_irt/anova_mirt.R"))

# directory in which to save model records
regdir <- here("models")

task_data_nested <- read_rds("data/task_data_nested.rds")
runs_mrot <- read_rds("data/runs_mrot.rds")
```

```{r}
# define set of multigroup models (Rasch/2PL x invariance)
models_multigroup <- tribble(
  ~nfact, ~itemtype, ~invariance,
       1,   "Rasch", "configural",
       1,   "Rasch", "scalar",
       1,     "2PL", "configural",
       1,     "2PL", "metric",
       1,     "2PL", "scalar",
)

# define priors (list where names are parameter names and values are vectors with priorType, val1, val2)
priors <- list(d = c("norm", 0, 3), a1 = c("norm", 1, 0.3))
```

```{r}
# fit multigroup models (grouped by dataset)
fit_task_models_multigroup(task_data = task_data_nested,
                           models = models_multigroup,
                           priors = priors,
                           task = "mrot",
                           group = dataset,
                           registry_dir = regdir)

# fit multigroup models (grouped by site)
fit_task_models_multigroup(task_data = task_data_nested,
                           models = models_multigroup,
                           priors = priors,
                           task = "mrot",
                           group = site,
                           registry_dir = regdir)
```

```{r}
# read in all models in regdir
mods <- list_models() |> load_models()

# extract model specifications from filenames
mods_coded <- mods |>
  mutate(file = str_remove(filename, "\\.rds$")) |>
  separate_wider_delim(file, names = c("task_dup", "itemtype", "nfact", "invariance"),
                       delim = "_", cols_remove = FALSE, too_few = "align_start") |>
  select(-task_dup) |>
  mutate(invariance = invariance |> replace_na(""))
```

```{r}
# extract each model's BIC
mods_overlap <- mods_coded |>
  filter(subset == "overlap_items") |>
  mutate(BIC = map_dbl(mod_rec, \(rec) rec@fit$BIC))

# best model on overlapping items
mods_best_overlap <- mods_overlap |>
  group_by(model_set) |>
  filter(BIC == min(BIC))

# all items model corresponding to best model above
mods_best_multigroup <- mods_coded |>
  filter(subset == "all_items") |>
  semi_join(mods_best_overlap |> select(model_set, itemtype, nfact, invariance))
```

```{r}
# extract scores
mod_scores <- mods_best_multigroup |>
  mutate(scores = map(mod_rec, scores)) |>
  select(task, model_set, itemtype, invariance, scores) |>
  unnest(scores) |>
  left_join(runs_mrot) |>
  rename(metric_value = ability, metric_se = se) |>
  mutate(metric_type = "ability")

write_rds(mod_scores, "models/mrot_scores.rds", compress = "gz")

extract_coefs <- \(mod_rec) {
  model_vals(mod_rec) |>
    as_tibble() |>
    filter(group != "GROUP", item != "GROUP") |>
    select(group, item, name, value) |>
    pivot_wider(names_from = name, values_from = value) |>
    mutate(item = str_remove(item, glue("{item_sep}[0-9]+$"))) |>
    distinct() |>
    mutate(difficulty = -d / a1) |>
    arrange(difficulty)
}

# extract item params
mod_coef <- mods_coded |>
  mutate(coefs = map(mod_rec, extract_coefs)) |>
  select(task, model_set, subset, itemtype, invariance, coefs) |>
  unnest(coefs)

write_rds(mod_coef, "models/mrot_coef.rds", compress = "gz")
```

```{r}
# reconstruct mirt objects out of model records
mod_obj <- mods_overlap |>
  mutate(mod = map(mod_rec, model_from_record))

# map multigroup model tibble to coding in mods
mod_map <- models_multigroup |>
  mutate(itemtype = itemtype |> str_to_lower(),
         nfact = paste0("f", nfact),
         model_order = 1:n())

# create anova of all multigroup models for each task
task_anova <- mod_obj |>
  # join in model list from fit_irt_modular.qmd for sequencing models
  left_join(mod_map) |>
  arrange(model_set, model_order) |>
  select(task, model_set, mod, nfact, itemtype, invariance, model_order) |>
  # mutate(logPrior = map_dbl(mod, \(m) m@Fit$logPrior)) |>
  # run anova for each task
  nest(mods = -c(task, model_set)) |>
  mutate(anova = map(mods, \(tm) anova_mirt_wrapper(tm$mod))) |>
  # remove model objects and flatten out anova results
  mutate(mod_info = map(mods, \(tm) tm |> select(-mod))) |>
  select(task, model_set, mod_info, anova) |>
  unnest(c(mod_info, anova))

write_rds(task_anova, here("models/mrot_anova.rds"), compress = "gz")
```
